text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
The split second before I cross the finish
line always feels like the most freeing
moment in the
world! It's seriously the
best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Do you get the same feeling when you
see me win
a race, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah?! I totes knew it! I'm so over the
moon right
now!
choice_data_list: Next time, let's run even more "fr...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But y'know, the reason why I can let
loose and run as fast as I want is 'cause
I've got an awesome
trainer backing me
up.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's keep up the great job!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Since we're hyped up to eleven anyway,
we might
as well go somewhere and
party it up!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Whoa, you want me to run even freer than I am now? No cap? That's wild!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
But I get the feeling I can actually do
it! I'm gonna keep one-upping my
performance every time I compete and
leave everyone gagged with how freely I
run!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
All right! I'm super hyped now! Let's
keep this
energy going!
